metadata.title: Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure‑SDLC)

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for delivering software artifacts securely and verifiably without granting deployment or execution authority.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Software factories, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, configuration, policy-as-code, and SDLC tooling.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern assembling all Secure‑SDLC solution and foundational patterns.

props.name: sdlc-model
props.remarks: Secure‑SDLC guarantees integrity, attribution, and assurance of artifacts but does not authorize deployment or execution.

props.name: nist-controls
props.value: SR, SA, SI, IA, CM, RA
props.remarks: Secure‑SDLC implements controls for secure development, supply chain risk management, change integrity, and assurance.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: SP 800-218 provides Secure SDLC practices; SP 800-160 provides supply chain risk management practices.

metadata.remarks: Secure‑SDLC composes foundational semantics and solution patterns governing software delivery. It applies to application code, scripts, automation, infrastructure-as-code, configuration, and policy-as-code artifacts. Secure‑SDLC outputs are necessary but insufficient for runtime execution.

components.title: SDLC Core
components.description: Defines SDLC scope, legitimacy, artifact coverage, and non‑equivalence rules.

components.title: SDLC Identity and Attribution
components.description: Provides attribution of SDLC actions to accountable human and automation identities.

components.title: SDLC Change Integrity
components.description: Ensures authorization and integrity of SDLC changes without granting deployment authority.

components.title: SDLC Assurance
components.description: Produces security assurance evidence for SDLC artifacts.

components.title: SDLC Supply Chain
components.description: Constrains and verifies third‑party and external inputs into the SDLC.

components.title: SDLC Operations Handover
components.description: Defines the trust boundary between SDLC completion and operational custody.
